Lore / Il Gioco Delle Beffe

Il Gioco delle Beffe

Calveno’s five-day prank festival. Teams design elaborate public hoaxes, execute them on willing marks, and leave their registered symbol at the scene to claim the score.

Shepherd Grigori left the party to attend festival business after the ship reached Calveno.

Structure

DayNameWhat Happens
1La Scelta, the ChoosingRegistration at the Mercatura bridge. Teams declare mark, category, scale, stake, and symbol. Marks are notified that morning.
2-4La Finestra, the WindowExecution window. Teams may strike at any hour and can use false alarms, sabotage, and misdirection.
5Il Giudizio, the JudgmentPranks are presented. Marks score surprise; committee scores craft and recovery. Winner announced at sundown.

Rules That Matter at the Table

  • Standard entry stake is 25 gp; Legendary-scale entries pay 50 gp.
  • Scoring is out of 20: Craft 10, Surprise 5, Recovery 5.
  • First place takes 60 percent of the pool, second 25 percent, third the remainder.
  • The Beffa Medallion is a bronze laughing mask awarded to the winning team leader.
  • A mark who was genuinely fooled often pays a goodwill gift of 10-50 gp.
  • Every team must leave its registered symbol at the scene. No symbol, no score.
  • A stolen symbol used in another team’s prank is a recognized gambit called a beffa doppia.

Current Hooks

  • Registration is tomorrow morning from the party’s current Calveno state.
  • Several Legendary declarations are expected, so the prize pool should be large.
  • Giacomo Moretti has signed the Accord for twenty years and has never been successfully pranked.
  • A Tessarine factor is on the list for the first time.
  • Prospero Morsani appears on the winner plaque, but his entry has no description.
  • The Six-Hour Wake record has stood for forty years.

DM Note

This is a live Calveno toy. Use buildings, contracts, symbols, public witnesses, and recovery problems rather than extra festival exposition.
